findings.summary: Toast is inserted into the DOM with its live region, so nothing is announced.
findings.fix: Render an empty aria-live="polite" container on mount and write the message into it.

findings.summary: The chat transcript is a live region whose whole contents are re-rendered, so screen readers re-read the entire conversation history.
findings.fix: Take the transcript out of the live region (role="log" with aria-live="off") and announce each completed turn through a separate visually hidden role="status" announcer.
